hero.title: Retrospectives that actually move your team forward
hero.subtitle: Prepare, run and close your retros online. Formats that fit your team and a history sprint after sprint: your ideas never get lost again.
hero.reassurance: No credit card · Available in English, French and Spanish

why.title: Why Reflecto?
why.subtitle: Everything you need for lively retros, without the paper-wall logistics.

custom.title: Retros that look like you
custom.text: Build your own formats: categories, descriptions, images and sticky note colors. Every team keeps its own style.

facilitation.title: Smooth facilitation
facilitation.text: The Scrum Master prepares the retro, starts it when everyone is ready, annotates sticky notes and closes the sprint in one click.

memory.title: A team memory
memory.text: Every retro is kept. Find the sticky notes and annotations from previous sprints to follow up on your actions.

step1.title: Create your team
step1.text: Sign up your company and invite your members.

step2.title: Collect ideas
step2.text: Everyone adds sticky notes to the retro categories.

step3.title: Decide and act
step3.text: Start the retro, discuss, annotate and close the sprint.

showcase.title: Your action items no longer fall through the cracks
showcase.text: Before starting a new sprint, look back at previous retros and check what really changed.
showcase.point1: History of every retro, per team

pricingTeaser.title: Start for free
pricingTeaser.text: The free plan covers 1 team and 3 members. Need more? Paid plans start at {price} per month.

finalCta.title: Your next retro can be your best one
finalCta.text: Create your team and run your first retro today.

contact.description3: Together, let’s make your retrospectives a driver of continuous improvement!

connection.description1: Simplify your agile retrospectives, engage your teams and turn every sprint into an opportunity for continuous improvement.
